svg.title: How Cheatcode_ fits together
svg.desc: Public sources feed a nightly listing job and an MCP recipe check into a catalog pinned to commits. The API ranks listings from recorded install events and signs install links. On the website the user presses Add; a signed link opens the Mac installer, which fetches the request and manifest, checks every sha256, writes into the chosen AI app and reports one install event.
svg.text: computes every number from recorded rows
shows every path it will write, then asks
checks every sha256, runs no package code
keeps a receipt, so Remove is exact
Press Add on a listing. A signed link that expires opens the app.
The app fetches that request and the package manifest from the API.
It checks every file's sha256, shows what it will write, then writes.
It reports one install event: a row, never a counter.
